page.overview:
Who is Boss Sumo Bro?

The Boss Sumo Bro is a minor antagonist in New Super Mario Bros. U. He guards the second fort of Rock-Candy Mines, where he is fought as a boss.

The Boss Sumo Bro wears two tsuna around his shoulders. His enlarged form gives him slanted lines for eyes. Both his small and enlarged forms have a spike on his head; therefore, if stomped, he will damage Mario instead of taking damage.

Boss Sumo Bro is a sub boss appearing in all three games. When faced, he starts out as an ordinary Sumo Bro, but after being exposed to Kamek's magic, he grows three times the normal size of a Sumo Bro, and begins to attack the player by jumping from platform to platform creating electric shockwaves to damage the player. Every time the Boss Sumo Bro performs his stomp attack, a tremor will rock the room, stunning Mario, but this can be avoided by jumping just before the stomp. Additionally, the Boss Sumo Bro's electric shockwaves have to hit the sides of the arena to fizzle out, rather than doing so automatically after a short distance. The player can attack Boss Sumo Bro by jumping from below the platforms he stands on to throw off his balance, from which then the player must jump on top of him to damage him. Due to the central platform being higher than the other two platforms, players have to use those platforms to reach that platform if the Boss Sumo Bro is on top of it. There are also Note Blocks in the centre of his room beneath that platform. After repeating this process three times, Boss Sumo Bro is defeated. Boss Sumo Bro takes 1/6 the damage he would take from a stomp attack if hit by a Fireball used via the Fire suit.

Unlike Boom Boom and Kamek, and like the Koopalings and Bowser himself in the castles and Bowser Jr. in the Airship levels, the Boss Sumo Bro is absent from the map for the most part. However, if Mario loses in Screwtop Tower and it is not yet completed, the Boss Sumo Bro will be seen standing on top of the tower, only to retreat into his fortress a few seconds later. After the player completes the level, the Boss Sumo Bro is shown getting sent flying by the flag appearing on top of his tower.
